problemSignature.risk: AI development could mutate user-owned board projects while product code evolves

rootCause: BoardForge development and real board experiments were previously interleaved, making it too easy for automation to treat user-owned ESC/FC projects as fixtures.
fixSummary: Add protected-path guardrails and productization run reports so AI commands refuse protected project paths by default.

conditions: user project path contains protected ESC/FC markers

recipe: Classify target path before any AI operation.
Reject protected ESC/FC paths unless explicit approval exists.
Keep synthetic fixture evolution in BoardForge_New_Board_Fixtures and code in BoardForge_Dev.
safetyRules: do not modify protected user projects

before.risk: code and board fixture work could happen under protected FN-ESC1 tree
